tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Upgrade your network infrastructure with the PC MikroTik 28 Threads  CPU 4×10G SFP+ Cloud Core Ethernet Router, a powerful custom-built routing solution designed for ISPs, data centers, and enterprise environments in Bangladesh. Built on high-core x86 architecture and powered by MikroTik RouterOS, this router delivers ultra-fast throughput, advanced routing capabilities, and unmatched scalability.


Key Features:

  • Processor (CPU): Intel Xeon E5-2680 v4, 2.40 GHz, Max Turbo 3.30 GHz, 35M Cache, Cores 14, Threads 28
  • MotherBoard: X99-XD4-V2.0 Server Motherboard 
  • RAM: DDR4 16GB ECC Server RAM
  • License:  Mikrotik License with SSD
  • Port: 4 Port 10G SFP+
  • Power Supply: 550W
  • Mount: 2U Rack Mount Casing
